assets.title: Strip diacritics in JavaScript with NFKD + \p{M}
assets.search_text: strip diacritics in javascript with nfkd + \p{m} unicode slug javascript normalization # strip diacritics in javascript with nfkd + \p{m} ## conclusion to fold accented latin letters to ascii without a dependency: ```js text.normalize("nfkd").replace(/\p{m}+/gu, "") ``` prefer **nfkd** over nfd: it additionally folds compatibility characters (`fi` → `fi`, full-width `abc` → `abc`). ## when it applies - slugs, search keys, file names, sort keys for latin-script text. - any node.js ≥ 10 / modern browser (`\p{...}` needs the `u` flag). ## when it does not - letters that are not "base letter + combining mark" survive unchanged: `ø`, `ß`, `ł`, `æ`, `đ`. handle them with an explicit table only if users need it. - non-latin scripts are not transliterated (`你好` stays `你好`). - do not use it to display names — it is lossy. ## how to verify ```text "crème brûlée" -> "creme brulee" "final abc" -> "final abc" "søren" -> "søren" (unchanged, known limitation) ``` ## source task-002 under spec-001/sc-004. the test `ac-005` failed before the change and passed after it; options compared in dec-001.
